name: BusinessMath: Swift Package for Financial Modeling and Analysis
highlights: Comprehensive Swift package for business mathematics, financial modeling, and statistical analysis
Test-Driven Development with 1,500+ tests achieving 100% pass rate across 3,457+ lines of production code
Declarative DSL using Swift result builders for intuitive financial model construction
ModelInspector for model validation and analysis, CalculationTrace for debugging, DataExporter for CSV/JSON export
Thread-safe CalculationCache with LRU eviction and TTL for performance optimization
High-performance implementation: 0.016ms for 150-component models, 9.1ms for 1000-point time series export
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enabling AI assistants to perform business calculations and statistical analysis
Advanced statistics: hypothesis testing (t-tests, chi-square, ANOVA), A/B testing, Monte Carlo simulation
Swift 6 strict concurrency compliance with modern language features
Comprehensive documentation with runnable examples and executable test suite
